scope: network only; software and maintenance redesign postponed
assertions: No-drift preserves every WireGuard file inode, mtime, mode and owner on peer and hub, plus unit active-since and InvocationID and live peers.
Deliberate allowed-IP drift and a removed hub entry are repaired even when the recorded digest matches.
VPN hub publishes the exact recorded peer list, prunes stale peer files and requires a recent recorded-peer handshake.
Private keys stay on their Nodes; they are absent from native outputs and Operation data.
scope_limits: Disposable recorded legacy hub and real SSH/WireGuard; no production traffic, scale or image redesign. The protected VPN bootstrap DNS backend is seeded through its existing renderer.

findings_fixed: Existing peer-DNS test import and applicability
Hub handshake from any admitted peer, without first-peer ICMP requirement
Shared converge/recipe Node and hub reservation, retained through native timeout settlement

rebase_note: Network product files are byte-identical to the passing receipts. Main additionally changed only the instance.destroy entry in the shared budget file; the node.converge budget is unchanged.
